stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 194 km apart and travel towards each other at 54 km/h and 20 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 54 + 20 = 74$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{194}{74} = 2.62$ hours.
